enum { LOG_MAX = 4000, TEXT_MAX = 400000, KEY_MAX = 64 };
static char g_text[TEXT_MAX];
static int g_textUsed;
static const char* g_log[LOG_MAX];
static int g_logCount;
static bool g_overflow;
static char g_buf[4096];
static bool g_firstArg;
struct SState { long Value[4]; };                       // PostSavePosition, CoreQuestWaiting, BreakSiegeFinished, BodyGuardsInLimbo
static const char* const g_fieldName[4] = { "PostSavePosition", "CoreQuestWaiting", "BreakSiegeFinished", "BodyGuardsInLimbo" };
static SState g_seen;
struct SAnswer { long Stage; const char* Key; const char* Pattern; };   // Stage -1 = any stage; the last letter of Pattern repeats
static const SAnswer* g_answers;
static char g_key[KEY_MAX][96];
static int g_keyAsks[KEY_MAX];
static int g_keyCount;
static long g_keyStage;
static int g_tCalls, g_stopT, g_frames, g_framesAfterGame, g_framesToRunAfterGame, g_afterStop;
static bool g_stopped;

static SState CurrentState();
static long CurrentStage();
static void Put(const char* text)
{
    int n = (int)strlen(text) + 1;
    if (g_stopped) ++g_afterStop;
    if (g_logCount >= LOG_MAX || g_textUsed + n > TEXT_MAX) { g_overflow = true; return; }
    memcpy(g_text + g_textUsed, text, n);
    g_log[g_logCount++] = g_text + g_textUsed;
    g_textUsed += n;
}
static void FlushState()
{
    SState now = CurrentState();
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        if (now.Value[i] != g_seen.Value[i]) {
            char line[64];
            sprintf(line, "%s=%ld", g_fieldName[i], now.Value[i]);
            Put(line);
            g_seen.Value[i] = now.Value[i];
        }
    }
}
static void Record(const char* text) { FlushState(); Put(text); }

// A question to the game: recorded like a call; the answer is the scenario's pattern for (stage, question), by default no / yes
// alternately, so that every plain wait loop runs exactly one frame.
static bool Ask()
{
    strcat(g_buf, ")");
    Record(g_buf);
    long stage = CurrentStage();
    if (stage != g_keyStage) { g_keyCount = 0; g_keyStage = stage; }
    int k = 0;
    while (k < g_keyCount && strcmp(g_key[k], g_buf) != 0) ++k;
    if (k == g_keyCount) {
        if (g_keyCount >= KEY_MAX || strlen(g_buf) >= sizeof(g_key[0])) { g_overflow = true; return true; }
        strcpy(g_key[g_keyCount], g_buf);
        g_keyAsks[g_keyCount++] = 0;
    }
    int n = g_keyAsks[k]++;
    for (const SAnswer* a = g_answers; a && a->Key; ++a) {
        if ((a->Stage == -1 || a->Stage == stage) && strcmp(a->Key, g_buf) == 0) {
            int len = (int)strlen(a->Pattern);
            return a->Pattern[n < len ? n : len - 1] == 'T';
        }
    }
    return (n & 1) != 0;
}

// The recorded run against the retail order: the two thread spawns, then everything from the stage's entry.  Every call must be
// the retail call, made with the four members holding what retail has stored by then.
static bool Matches(const SScenario& s, long stage)
{
    SState cur, act;
    cur.Value[0] = stage; cur.Value[1] = CQW_START; cur.Value[2] = 0; cur.Value[3] = 1;
    act = cur;
    int i = 0, calls = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j <= g_logCount; ++j) {
        const char* got = j < g_logCount ? g_log[j] : 0;
        long v;
        int f = got ? StateField(got, &v) : -1;
        if (f >= 0) { act.Value[f] = v; continue; }
        if (calls == 2) i = StageIndex(stage);
        for (;;) {
            const SExpected& e = g_expected[i];
            if (!e.Text) break;
            if (e.Region != ' ' && (e.Region == 'L' || !strchr(s.Active, e.Region))) { ++i; continue; }
            f = StateField(e.Text, &v);
            if (f < 0) break;
            cur.Value[f] = v;
            ++i;
        }
        const char* want = g_expected[i].Text;
        bool same = memcmp(&cur, &act, sizeof(cur)) == 0;
        if ((want || got) && (!want || !got || strcmp(want, got) != 0 || !same)) {
            sprintf(g_why, "stage %ld, call %d: retail has \"%.150s\", the script made \"%.150s\"%s", stage, calls, want ? want : "(nothing more)",
                got ? got : "(nothing more)", same ? "" : " with different member values");
            return false;
        }
        if (!same) { sprintf(g_why, "stage %ld: member values at the end differ", stage); return false; }
        if (!got) break;
        ++i;
        ++calls;
    }
    return true;
}

    msg1 = Count("HeroReceiveMessageFromGuildMaster(TEXT_QST_078_GM_MSG_KNOTHOLE_GLADE_CLOSED,,1,1)")
        + Count("HeroReceiveMessageFromGuildMaster(TEXT_QST_078_GM_MOTHER_LEFT_YOU_THIS,,1,1)");
    save1 = Count("AutoSave()"); frames1 = g_frames; checks1 = g_tCalls;
    Check(story1 == 1 && msg1 == 2 && Count("AddLogbookStoryEntry(170)") == 0 && Count("AddLogbookStoryEntryString(TEXT_QST_LOG_STORY_PLATINUM_305)") == 1
        && Count("AddLogbookStoryEntryString(TEXT_QST_LOG_STORY_PLATINUM_300)") == 0, "scenario 1 branch calls");
    CheckScenario(g_scenario2, "scenario 2");
    Run(g_scenario2, EGP_INTRO, 0, 1);
    Check(Count("AddLogbookStoryEntry(170)") == 1 && Count("AddLogbookStoryEntry(175)") == 0 && Count("AddLogbookStoryEntryString(TEXT_QST_LOG_STORY_PLATINUM_300)") == 1
        && Count("GiveHeroQuestCardDirectly(OBJECT_QUEST_CARD_MAZE_RESEARCH,V_MazeResearch,0)") == 1 && Count("GiveHeroObject(OBJECT_TATTOO_CARD_CHEST_CUSTOM_01,-1,1)") == 0
        && Count("RemoveQuestCardFromGuild(Q_OrchardFarmRaidGood)") == 1 && Count("RemoveQuestCardFromGuild(Q_OrchardFarmRaidEvil)") == 0, "scenario 2 branch calls");
    // (3) values without a case: the two threads are spawned and nothing else happens
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof(g_noCase) / sizeof(g_noCase[0]); ++k) {
        Run(g_scenario1, g_noCase[k], 0, 1);
        Check(g_logCount == 2 && strcmp(g_log[0], g_expected[0].Text) == 0 && strcmp(g_log[1], g_expected[1].Text) == 0 && g_end.Value[0] == g_noCase[k]
            && g_end.Value[1] == CQW_START && g_frames == 0 && g_tCalls == 0, "a stage value without a case");
    }
    // (5) the loops
    Run(g_scenario3, EGP_INTRO, 0, 3);
    Check(!g_overflow && g_end.Value[0] == EGP_FINISHED_GAME && g_framesAfterGame == 3, "scenario 3 reaches the end and runs three frames there");
    // orchard wait: two idle frames (each asks good, then evil, then one frame), then the evil raid: check, frame, check, card removed
    Check(Count("IsQuestActive(Q_OrchardFarmRaidGood)") == 3 && Count("IsQuestActive(Q_OrchardFarmRaidEvil)") == 3
        && Count("RemoveQuestCardFromGuild(Q_OrchardFarmRaidGood)") == 1 && Count("RemoveQuestCardFromGuild(Q_OrchardFarmRaidEvil)") == 0, "orchard wait loop");
    // orchard raid: both asked on each of three passes, two frames
    Check(Count("MsgOnQuestCompleted(Q_OrchardFarmRaidEvil)") == 3 && Count("MsgOnQuestCompleted(Q_OrchardFarmRaidGood)") == 3, "orchard raid loop");
    // message loops: given on entering the region, not again while inside, again after leaving and coming back
    Check(Count("IsRegionLoaded(KnotholeGlade)") == 5 && Count("HeroReceiveMessageFromGuildMaster(TEXT_QST_078_GM_MSG_KNOTHOLE_GLADE_CLOSED,,1,1)") == 2, "Knothole Glade message loop");
    Check(Count("HeroReceiveMessageFromGuildMaster(TEXT_QST_078_GM_MOTHER_LEFT_YOU_THIS,,1,1)") == 2 && Count("AutoSave()") == save1 + 1, "guild letter message loop");
    Check(Count("AddLogbookStoryEntryString(TEXT_QST_LOG_STORY_PLATINUM_305)") == 0 && Count("AddLogbookStoryEntryString(TEXT_QST_LOG_STORY_PLATINUM_300)") == 0
        && Count("GiveHeroQuestCardDirectly(OBJECT_QUEST_CARD_MAZE_RESEARCH,V_MazeResearch,0)") == 0 && Count("SetCategoryActivity(AFTER_FINAL_BATTLE_GLOBAL,1)") == 1, "JackBossBattleResult 0");
    // frames: scenario 1 runs one frame per wait; scenario 3 adds 2 (orchard wait) + 2 (orchard raid) + 4 (Knothole) + 3 (letter) + 2 (end)
    // and drops the two tutorial waits (2)
    Check(g_frames == frames1 + 2 + 2 + 4 + 3 + 2 - 2, "frame count of scenario 3");
    (void)checks1;
    printf(g_failures ? "00ce7670_TEST FAIL\n" : "00ce7670_TEST PASS\n");
    return g_failures ? 1 : 0;
